purpose: Teach: 素質/各界/度胸/議事堂/飽和/イニシアチブ/肝要/切り取っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の素質を見極めろ
lines.en: Assess the potential of our newcomers carefully.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative tone. Lean forward slightly on 「素質を」. Expect compliance. Steady eye contact, no room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各界の有識者の意見を伺います
lines.en: Understood. I'll gather perspectives from leading voices in each field.
lines.style: Crisp affirmation. Slight nod. Efficient, businesslike. Taking mental notes. Professional respect in the voice — not obsequious, just competent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、難しい交渉も度胸でいけ
lines.en: Difficult negotiations — handle them with decisiveness.
lines.style: Clipped, emphatic on 「度胸」. Slight pause before the final instruction. Not a question. Conviction without drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。議事堂前の表敬訪問を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the courtesy visit to the Diet building.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Quick, matter-of-fact delivery. Already mentally moving to the next task. No wasted breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市場の飽和状態に対応しろ
lines.en: Respond to this market saturation. Now.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. Hard stop on the full stop. The word 「飽和」 lands with weight. This is urgent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界でイニシアチブを取ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll take the initiative in our sector.
lines.style: Quick assent. Confident, forward-momentum delivery. No hesitation. The words carry intention — not just yes, but *yes, I have a plan*.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、危機対応では肝要な判断を即決しろ
lines.en: In a crisis, the decisions that matter most must be made immediately.
lines.style: Grave, considered weight. Slow on 「肝要」. Pause before 「即決」 — let that word sit. This is the core instruction. Almost grave.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料から重要部分を切り取って共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll extract the critical points from the data and circulate them.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Clipped, professional close. The kind of yes that means the conversation is over and work begins. Efficient exhale at the end.
